text:
The description is built by `summary.build`, not in `routing.py`. `routing.py` only writes it to a file and hands that file to `gh`.

ARTIFACT gap_finding: `routing.py` 485-531 only delivers the pull request description; `summary.py` `build` (136-178) holds its content, in `plugins/temperspec-tgraph/workflow/temperspec/`. Delivery in `routing.py` (all read): `_body_file` (488-501) writes `summary.build(ctx)` to `.tempergraph/pull-request.md` in the workspace. It adds a `.gitignore` containing `*` there, so no step commits it. It returns the workspace-relative path (CHK-B11 forbids absolute paths), or "" on any exception, because a description never fails the last stage. `finalize` (504-531) skips with manual steps when the branch name is unsafe, there is no `origin`, or the push fails. If `gh pr list` finds an open pull request, it runs `gh pr edit <url> --body-file`, outcome `reused`, with the reason noting when the description was not updated. Otherwise it runs `gh pr create --draft --fill [--base] --head <branch> [--body-file]`; outcome is `opened`, or `pushed` with manual steps. Tests assert the `--body-file` commands (`test_temperspec.py` 714 and 733). The content of `build`, in order (read; body headings tested in `test_conversation.py` 359-449): `## temperspec run <id>`, then `Lane:` (quick, plan, discovery or discovery-only, from the route value); `### Acceptance criteria of the task` (triage note, at most MAX_LINES=14); `### Decided` (answered owner decisions, only when the pause kept answers); `### Assumptions to confirm` (only when the note has an Owner decisions section); `### Read these` (changed `.spec.md` lines, with decision records listed by path, or "No spec and no decision record changed"); then `### Decisions taken` and `### Open questions` (hand-off) and `### Deviations from the plan` (code report), each only when non-empty; then `### The change` (counts of code, spec and decision files) with up to 6 `Verification` lines of the code report; then a line naming the hand-over notes by path; the last line says the gates checked it and no person has read it. A new section, for example not-blocking findings, would go in `build` and would need a new line in the docs. Specs: `conversation.spec.md` lines 66 and 77 (CONV-B7, CONV-B8) state only the Assumptions and Decided sections. No spec states the rest of the description or the `routing.py` delivery. Plans `i60.plan.md` row R6 and `i63-64.plan.md` row R7 record how the two sections were added.
